description: Anzère is the resort locality in the municipality of Ayent, on a sunny plateau at about 1500 metres, and there is no village named Ayent itself. Compact alpine chalets face a wide southern view of the high Valais peaks across the Rhône valley. Late-September grass on the plateau is tawny, with snow only on the distant high summits. The Open-Meteo model is broken cloud and cool, with no precipitation.
